The snapped route-line endpoint is about 55-62 m from the official First Camp / Etapp 6-7 POI.
Older official material says Rödåkra about 1 km west is served by line 405, but current Västtrafik information says line 405 is withdrawn/replaced and Rödåkra is withdrawn for regional traffic.
Some tourism/operator text calls Hökensås a nature reserve or national park, but Länsstyrelsen legal/current wording is naturvårdsområde.

Older trail/PDF language can imply blanket reserve fire bans, while Hökensås/Hyltan legal rules allow fire at designated/prepared places unless current fire bans override. Hökensås Sportfiske local rules can be stricter.
